resources.string: Bookmarks stay in ordinary local browsing storage. A page is visited only after you tap Open. Clearing cookies or disabling tab restore does not remove bookmarks.
Reading or saving bookmarks is not confirmed. Check available storage, then read again.
No bookmarks yet. Open a webpage, then choose Bookmark this page.
The limit of %1$d bookmarks has been reached. Remove a bookmark you no longer need first.
Bookmark storage is responding slowly. Waiting for this operation to finish.
The page changed or has not finished loading. Choose Bookmark this page again on the current page.
